title: Amazon Linux 2023 - ALAS2023-2026-3159: Important priority package update for python-hpack
description:
Package updates are available for Amazon Linux 2023 that fix the following vulnerabilities:
CVE-2026-59980:
	A flaw was found in hpack, an HTTP/2 Header Encoding for Python. Unbounded variable integer decoding can lead to excessive computation when processing specially crafted, malformed input. A remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability to cause a denial of service by effectively blocking further processing within the affected component.
